newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar surges ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar surges ahead of weekend.

text.p: London white sugar surged late on Friday and wrapped up the week at the highs on the back of a speculative New York-led rally.
October whites surged $4.30 to finish at $328.50, as trade and commission house buying followed on a flurry of fund buying in October raws in New York.
December also ended at the day's high of $325.00, up $3.40 from Thursday's finish.
However, total volume was unexceptional at 1,747 lots.
In New York, CSCE October sugar was up 0.16 cent at 11.71 cents a pound midday, after seeing a morning high of 11.76 cents.
Commission house buying late on Thursday had pushed October whites through initial trendline resistance at $324 and strength in the raws propelled it higher still.
The Paris market was closed due to a public holiday.
